mapper.sql: SD.OrderNo AS orderNo, SD.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo AS orderChangeNo, SD.OrderState AS orderState, SD.ShopCode AS shopCode, SD.ChnlCode AS chnlCode, Ch.ChnlName AS chnlName, SD.SlnkOrderCode AS slnkOrderCode, SD.DeliCompName AS deliCompName, DC.SlnkDeliName AS slnkDeliName, SD.InvNo AS invNo, CAST(SD.ShipCmpletDate AS CHAR) AS shipCmpletDate, SD.OrderName AS orderName, SD.RecverName AS recverName
FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SD LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = SD.ChnlCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpDeliComp DC ON DC.DeliCompName = SD.DeliCompName
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE SD.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND SD.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND SD.OrderChangeNo = #{orderChangeNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCmpDeliComp WHERE DeliCompName = #{name}
